Anika (Docs): Hey team — publishing SDK 2.4.0 and a docs refresh now. This includes a new migration guide for adapter plugins and a small breaking rename for one retry param. Quick note: please read before you upgrade. https://docs.redwood.com/sdk/2.4.0 :loudspeaker:
Ravi (Eng): Nice — what's the breaking rename?
Anika (Docs): The old param `retry_jitter` is renamed to `backoff_jitter` for clarity. Behavior is the same, but callers with explicit kwarg names will need to update. We added a compat shim for one release to ease rollouts.
Carlos (SDK): Compat shim info: we added `redwood_sdk.compat.LegacyClient` — it maps `retry_jitter` -> `backoff_jitter` at init. We recommend upgrading callsites, shim will be removed in two releases. Example:
```python
# temporary shim usage
from redwood_sdk.compat import LegacyClient
client = LegacyClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(prompt='hi')
```
Maya (Product): Timeline? we should sync with marketing + support on banners / console notices.
Anika (Docs): Plan: staged comms — console banner + in-app doc links next week, email to active org owners 2026-04-02, deprecation/removal of shim targeted for 2026-06-30. We'll post a clear migration checklist in the guide.
support-lead: tagging to confirm support playbook — we'll prepare canned responses + rollback steps.
docs-bot: Migration guide uploaded: https://docs.redwood.com/sdk/migration/adapters-2-4 (includes code diffs and quicksearch).
Ravi (Eng): Any perf or behavioral changes we should watch for?
Carlos (SDK): No perf regression in our tests. We did tighten `embeddings.batch_size` default from 256 -> 128 for better p99 memory on older instances; customers using large batch sizes should validate. Also note: default streaming framing changed slightly — structured tool-calls still same contract.
Anika (Docs): Action items: 1) SDK: publish release notes and compat examples (Carlos) 2) Docs: add migration checklist + sample diffs (Anika) 3) Support: canned responses (support-lead) 4) Product: schedule console banner (Maya).
Carlos (SDK): I've pushed the release candidate to the artifact repo and CI is green. We'll cut the tag at EOD and merge the compat README.
Maya (Product): I'll coordinate the banner and the email copy — will loop in comms.
Ravi (Eng): We'll run e2e on Dedicated and Private to ensure no regressions; ping me if you want to triage fast failures.
Anika (Docs): Thanks all. Small note for integrators: if you use `from redwood_sdk import Client` nothing changes; only code that passed `retry_jitter=` by name needs an update. We'll add a migration search snippet to the guide to help with large repos. :white_check_mark:
Carlos (SDK): FYI: temporary CLI shim added too — `rw-sdk migrate-jitter` will auto-patch simple callsites in python files. Use with review.
support-lead: We'll add that CLI tip to the support KB.
Anika (Docs): Ok closing thread — will post final release link here when tag is cut. :tada:
